summary_en: Kachitas Co., Ltd. to acquire all shares of Tobu Jyuhan Co., Ltd. at 2,000 yen per share over a 35-business-day period from October 14 to December 3, 2026, with a minimum purchase target of 1,776,600 shares (representing 65.64% post-acquisition stake). The target company's board approved the offer and recommended shareholder acceptance.
title_en: Notice of Endorsement and Recommendation of Tender Offer for Shares of Tobu Jyuhan Co., Ltd. by Kachitas Co., Ltd.
translation_en_brief:
On October 13, 2026, Tobu Jyuhan Co., Ltd. announced that its board of directors approved and endorsed a tender offer by Kachitas Co., Ltd. to acquire all outstanding shares of the company at 2,000 yen per share. The tender offer will run for 35 business days from October 14 through December 3, 2026. The minimum purchase target is 1,776,600 shares, which would result in Kachitas holding a post-acquisition stake of 65.64% based on voting rights as of May 31, 2026. The board recommended that shareholders accept the offer, noting that the transaction aims to make Tobu Jyuhan a wholly owned subsidiary of Kachitas and will result in delisting from the stock exchange.

Kachitas is a major real estate rehabilitation company, with Nitori Holdings holding a 34.14% stake as of March 31, 2026. The two companies have existing transaction relationships involving real estate brokerage and inventory transactions. The board approval included confirmation that independent directors unanimously approved the offer and all audit committee members raised no objection, ensuring fair process.
